evidence.summary: The US Entity List names it with the alias “Aviation Industry Corporation of China’s (AVIC) Institute 625”, added in a January 2018 revision. AVIC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists, and says its businesses include aviation weapons and equipment and military transport aircraft.

The US Commerce Department listed it in May 2014, finding reasonable cause to believe that it had supplied Iran’s ballistic missile programme through a Chinese proliferator whom the US government had sanctioned.
It belongs to AVIC, which describes itself as a very large state-owned enterprise managed by the central government.
